scope: Standard optional/result/value operations and physical-name object lookup. Existing containers, fieldNames/nil semantics and runtime bridges are reused.

entries.name: mapOption
entries.scope: Map one present payload to a new Maybe; absent input skips transform; Some(null) stays present.

entries.name: filterOption
entries.scope: Retain the same present container when an int predicate accepts its payload; absent or rejected input yields absence.

entries.name: orElse
entries.scope: Return the existing payload record or an already evaluated fallback record; result is not a Maybe.

entries.name: orElseGet
entries.scope: Return the payload record; invoke a nullary fallback only when absent.

entries.name: orElseOption
entries.scope: Return the original present Maybe, or call the nullary fallback once and return its Maybe unchanged.

entries.name: foldOption
entries.scope: Invoke exactly one branch, a nullary absent branch or unary payload branch; return its typed result record.

entries.name: flattenOption
entries.scope: Flatten one Maybe-of-Maybe level, retaining the nested container identity; absent outer input skips payload access.

entries.name: mapResult
entries.scope: Map only success payload into a fresh ok result; retain the existing error container without invoking transform.

entries.name: mapErr
entries.scope: Map only error payload into a fresh err result; retain the existing success container without invoking transform.

entries.name: orElseResult
entries.scope: Invoke one error-to-Result continuation only on err; return its Result without nesting; success identity retained.

entries.name: foldResult
entries.scope: Invoke exactly one unary branch with the corresponding typed payload; return its result record.

entries.name: attempt
entries.scope: Invoke through existing FxTry; return ok(result record) or err(typed reference record to full original FxOutcome); kernel/admission failures propagate.

entries.name: tap
entries.scope: Call one effect with the actual typed payload and return the exact original value record; no deep copying or swallowing failure.

entries.name: findField
entries.scope: Maybe of the selected physical field record; required zero-based occurrence counts equal ready names only; no payload evaluation.

entries.name: hasField
entries.scope: Whether that physical named occurrence exists; named uninitialized payloads count as present; no payload evaluation.

entries.name: getField
entries.scope: Return the existing selected field record; missing or negative occurrence raises FxIndex; no payload evaluation.

support_definitions.purpose: One ordinary copied input contract shared by findField/hasField/getField

record_contract: Ordinary true-result admission follows FxBind/FxBindResult. No unconditional dereference of container results and no mandatory extra @ box.
